title: Weight distributions for the residual H_b self-orthogonal codes
summary: Determine the exact weight distributions of the named Wang--Heng H_b code family in the cases left open by the source.

formal_statement.body: Let $F$ be the quadratic vectorial dual-bent function in Eq. (10) of the TIT source, let $t=m$, and let $H_b=\{x^b:x\in\mathbb F_{p^m}^{*}\}$ for $1\le b<p^m-1$ with $b\mid(p^m-1)$. For every residual divisor $b$ not covered by Theorem 3, determine the complete weight distribution of the self-orthogonal code $C_{D_F,H_b}$ from Wang--Heng, Theorem 23.

scope.domain: Self-orthogonal codes from the Wang--Heng vectorial dual-bent H_b defining sets
assumptions: F is the quadratic function in Eq. (10) and t=m
1 <= b < p^m-1 and b divides p^m-1
b=1, b=2, and the special Theorem 3(iv) divisibility cases are excluded because the source computes them
parameters: the fixed quadratic F and the H_b defining set
scope.unresolved_remainder: The exact weight distribution for every residual admissible divisor b in the named Wang--Heng Theorem 23 family remains unresolved.

citations.label: Wang--Wei--Fu--Li, Self-Orthogonal Codes From Vectorial Dual-Bent Functions
citations.locator: Remark 5, journal p. 141; Theorem 3 boundary cases

progress.summary: Remark 5 reports that Wang--Heng's H_b code family is self-orthogonal but its weight distribution was not determined.
citation_labels: Wang--Wei--Fu--Li, Self-Orthogonal Codes From Vectorial Dual-Bent Functions
